cmd: set -e; D=/opt/trading-bot/genetic; cd /opt/weather-pipeline/repo; git fetch -q origin; git show origin/main:bot/genetic/genetic.py > $D/genetic.py; mkdir -p $D/feat $D/feat_short; cp $D/index.html $D/feat/index.html; cp $D/index.html $D/feat_short/index.html; chown -R tbot:tbot $D; su -s /bin/sh tbot -c "cd $D && nohup sh -c \"GEN_OUT=$D/feat GEN_POP=200 GEN_GENS=40 GEN_NOISE=3 GEN_WORKERS=2 nice -n 19 /opt/trading-bot/venv/bin/python genetic.py > run_feat.log 2>&1; GEN_TFS=15m,30m GEN_OUT=$D/feat_short GEN_POP=200 GEN_GENS=40 GEN_NOISE=3 GEN_WORKERS=2 nice -n 19 /opt/trading-bot/venv/bin/python genetic.py > run_feat_short.log 2>&1\" > /dev/null 2>&1 &"; sleep 30; tail -2 $D/run_feat.log | cut -c1-200
